notes: This file is a PLACEHOLDER. No Hijri-year data has been imported yet.
Range 1356-1500 AH chosen because the Saudi Umm al-Qura calendar was
formally adopted in 1356 AH (1937 CE) — earlier years are not covered
by the official Saudi reference. Range will be confirmed against the
actual data source before Stage B (the behaviour-flip migration).
Until 'status' transitions away from 'data-pending', the calendar
consumer code MUST continue to use the existing Kuwaiti tabular
algorithm in js/hijri-date.js + server.js. The helpers in
js/hijri-umm-al-qura.js are wired only to Node-side tests in
scripts/_smoke_hijri_umm_al_qura_a0.mjs — no HTML page loads them
and no SSR route reads from this file.
